lines.en: label day333part2:
scene doubledate1
: Help.
lines.zh: : 救命。

lines.en: : This strange man is following me and I think I’m in danger.
lines.zh: : 这个奇怪的男人在跟踪我，我觉得我有危险。

lines.en: : Wow.
lines.zh: : 哇哦。

lines.en: : You know, I’ve been thinking about it for a while, but you really don’t look like you should be working here.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我想这事有一阵子了，你看起来真的不像该在这儿工作的人。

lines.en: : Thanks, Osako. It’s nice to see you too.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Osako。我也很高兴见到你。

lines.en: : School hours are over. I can’t do anything for you.
lines.zh: : 已经放学了。我帮不了你什么。

lines.en: : If you are still alive when[school] opens tomorrow-
lines.zh: : 如果明天[school]开门的时候你还活着——

lines.en: : Actually, just find someone else. I don't want to deal with this.
lines.zh: : 算了，找别人去吧。我可不想掺和这事。

lines.en: : She’s not in danger anyway. We’re just both heading in the same general direction and apparently that grosses her out or something.
lines.zh: : 反正她也没有危险。我们只是恰好往同一个大方向走，显然这让她觉得恶心什么的。

lines.en: scene doubledate2
: Fair enough.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。

lines.en: : That’s a perfectly acceptable reason to be disgusted. You’re the scum of the earth.
lines.zh: : 这完全是个能让人恶心的理由。你就是人渣。

lines.en: : I’m somehow relieved that you’re not as popular with adults as you are with [teenager]s.
lines.zh: : 不知为何，听说你在成年人里并不像在[teenager]里那么受欢迎，我反而松了口气。

lines.en: : Yeah, don’t worry Maya. These two are too in love with one another to ever fall for me anyway.
lines.zh: : 是啊，别担心 Maya。她俩爱彼此爱得死去活来，怎么也不会看上我的。

lines.en: scene doubledate3
: Oh! Hahahaha...
lines.zh: : 哦！哈哈哈哈……

lines.en: : I...don’t know if Wakana really wants word of that getting out in her workplace...
lines.zh: : 我……不知道 Wakana 是不是真想让这种话在她的工作场所传开……

lines.en: : You said something I don’t inherently despise for once. How nice.
lines.zh: : 你总算说了句我从骨子里不讨厌的话。真不错。

lines.en: : Uhh...congratulations. But I’ll be going now.
lines.zh: : 呃……恭喜。不过我要走了。

lines.en: : I don’t really see how any of this relates to me.
lines.zh: : 我真看不出这些跟我有什么关系。

lines.en: : Don’t you want to be part of a cool adult conversation where all of us do cool adult stuff and you get to feel included?
lines.zh: : 你难道不想参与一场酷酷的成年人对话吗？我们大家一起做酷酷的成年人的事，你还能有参与感呢？

lines.en: scene doubledate4
: Do you really think that’s the kind of stuff that I’m interested in?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得我会对那种东西感兴趣？

lines.en: : I may act mature for my age, but I’m still a [teenage]girl and would much prefer to hang out with people that aren’t paying homeowner's insurance.
lines.zh: : 我也许表现得比同龄人成熟，但我终究还是个[teenage]女孩，更想跟那些不用交房屋保险的人混在一起。

lines.en: : Now stop following me.
lines.zh: : 现在别再跟着我了。

lines.en: : Heh...You look sort of like a kitten right now, Osako.
lines.zh: : 呵……Osako，你现在看起来有点像只小猫。

lines.en: : Do you mind if I pet you?
lines.zh: : 介意我摸摸你吗？

lines.en: : Isn’t this fun, Maya? We’re about to watch lesbians do lesbian stuff.
lines.zh: : 是不是很有意思，Maya？我们马上要看女同做女同的事了。

lines.en: : Yes. Hooray. Again, this has nothing to do with me.
lines.zh: : 是啊。好耶。再说一遍，这跟我没关系。

lines.en: scene doubledate5
: Hey! Uhh...Wakana and me were just going to go out for coffee and-
lines.zh: : 嘿！呃……我和 Wakana 正打算出去喝咖啡，然后——

lines.en: : Wakana and {i}I{/i}, my cute little kitten.
lines.zh: : 是 Wakana 和{i}我{/i}，我可爱的小猫咪。

lines.en: : Wakana and I were about to go out for coffee and...if you two aren’t doing anything...why not come with us?
lines.zh: : Wakana 和我正要去喝咖啡，而且……如果你们俩没什么事的话……为什么不一起呢？

lines.en: : No thanks.
lines.zh: : 不用了，谢谢。

lines.en: : Sure. I’m okay with it if Maya is.
lines.zh: : 好啊。Maya 同意我就同意。

lines.en: scene doubledate6
: Have you just given up on paying any attention to me for the rest of the day now that all of the world ending stuff is out of the way?
lines.zh: : 现在那些灭级别的事都处理完了，你是不是就打算今天剩下的时间干脆不理我了？

lines.en: : World ending stuff?
lines.zh: : 灭级别的事？

lines.en: : Long story. But also, yes.
lines.zh: : 说来话长。不过，没错。

lines.en: : We finished our formally scheduled conversation and are now free for the rest of the day.
lines.zh: : 我们结束了正式安排的那场谈话，接下来这一天都空着。

lines.en: : And if you leave now, I’d just wind up following you to your dorm and forcing you to hang out with me anyway.
lines.zh: : 而且你要是现在走了，我也只会一路跟到你的宿舍，逼你陪我玩。

lines.en: : Is...it really okay for you to say stuff like that in[school]?
lines.zh: : 在[school]里说这种话……真的没问题吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know these people. What reason is there for me to join all of you when-
lines.zh: : 我又不认识这两个人。我有什么理由要跟你们一起——

lines.en: : I’ll buy you food.
lines.zh: : 我请你吃饭。

lines.en: scene doubledate7
: Mmh!
: Did you just scoff at me?
lines.zh: : 你刚刚是在嗤笑我吗？

lines.en: : You tapped into one of my weaknesses and now I’m having a hard time declining.
lines.zh: : 你戳中了我的弱点之一，现在我很难拒绝了。

lines.en: scene doubledate8
: If it makes you feel any better, I’ve kicked this guy’s ass on multiple occasions now and could easily intervene if he tries to pull anything on you.
lines.zh: : 如果这能让你好受点的话，我已经揍过这家伙好几次了，他要是敢对你动什么歪脑筋，我随时能出手。

lines.en: : Thank you. That does make me feel slightly better.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。这确实让我好受了一点。

lines.en: : Peculiar.
lines.zh: : 奇怪。

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 什么意思？

lines.en: : I had just assumed this girl was one of your concubines due to her outburst when that pink haired anarchist professed her love to you.
lines.zh: : 我只是以为这姑娘是你的妃子之一，毕竟那个粉头发的无政府主义者向你表白时她反应那么大。

lines.en: scene doubledate9
: Okay. If we’re going to get coffee or whatever, let’s do it now.
lines.zh: : 好了。如果真要去喝咖啡什么的，现在就走吧。

lines.en: : There’s no use standing around talking about things that don’t matter to anyone when there are...bagels and stuff.
lines.zh: : 明明还有……贝果什么的，站在这儿聊些对谁都不重要的东西毫无意义。

lines.en: : That’s a bit of a touchy subject seeing as I just had to convince Maya not to murder that girl less than twenty minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 这话题有点敏感，毕竟不到二十分钟前我才刚劝住 Maya 别去杀了那个女孩。

lines.en: : Huh.
: Well, I never have to be convinced to {i}not{/i} talk about something, so that’s fine.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我从来不需要别人劝我{i}别{/i}谈某件事，所以没问题。

lines.en: : But if you two are coming, please try to keep conversation to a minimum.
lines.zh: : 不过如果你们俩真要来，请尽量少说话。

lines.en: : Just don’t bring up stars or religion or whatever and I’m sure that much will be doable.
lines.zh: : 只要别提星星、宗教什么的，我想这点还是做得到的。

lines.en: scene doubledate10
: I hope you’re aware that you are the actual bane of my existence.
lines.zh: : 希望你清楚，你就是我这辈子的克星。

lines.en: : I hope you’re aware that you have an allowance for this double date and that I will not be bankrupted by a girl with a bottomless pit for a stomach.
lines.zh: : 希望你清楚，这次四人约会是有预算的，我可不会被一个胃是无底洞的姑娘吃破产。

lines.en: : A...double date, huh?
lines.zh: : 四人……约会，是吗？

lines.en: : That’s actually really cute if we...ignore the fact that one of the girls isn’t old enough to drink and is...going out with her teacher.
lines.zh: : 其实还挺可爱的……如果我们忽略其中一个女孩还没到饮酒年龄、而且在跟自己的老师约会这一点的话。

lines.en: : Don’t call it a date. I didn’t agree to that.
lines.zh: : 别叫它约会。我没同意过这个说法。

lines.en: : I’m just hungry.
lines.zh: : 我只是饿了。

lines.en: : Well then, like you said, there’s no use standing around.
lines.zh: : 那么，就像你说的，站着也没意义。

lines.en: scene black
Maya grabs her coat out of her locker and the four of us leave the[school] together.
lines.zh: Maya 从储物柜里拿出外套，我们四个一起离开了[school]。

lines.en: We begin walking in the opposite direction of the path I normally take home and it quickly becomes clear to me that there are still a lot of places in Kumon-mi that I’m not familiar with yet.
lines.zh: 我们朝我平时回家的反方向走去，我很快就意识到，Kumon-mi 还有很多地方是我不熟悉的。

lines.en: We pass by the takoyaki stand Maya brought me to a long time ago and I notice that it’s closed for the winter.
lines.zh: 我们路过 Maya 很久以前带我去过的那个章鱼烧摊子，我注意到它冬天歇业了。

lines.en: Either that or the old man running it died and left it to rot.
lines.zh: 要么就是经营它的老爷子死了，把摊子丢在这儿烂掉。

lines.en: I wonder how many pounds of octopus still linger within the confines of the cart’s freezers?
lines.zh: 我好奇那辆推车的冷冻柜里还剩下多少磅章鱼？

lines.en: I wonder how rotted they’ve become and if any insects have managed to crawl their way inside to feed off of the-
lines.zh: 我好奇它们已经烂成了什么样，又有没有虫子爬进去啃食——

lines.en: : Okay! We’re here.
lines.zh: : 好了！我们到了。

lines.en: : Oh.
: That was...extremely quick.
lines.zh: : 这……也太快了吧。

lines.en: scene doubledate11
scene doubledate12
: So...now what?
lines.zh: : 那么……接下来干嘛？

lines.en: : Wakana and {i}I{/i} haven’t been on a double date since college.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}和 Wakana 从大学以后就没再搞过四人约会了。

lines.en: : Please...don’t call it that. I just want to eat.
lines.zh: : 拜托……别这么叫。我只是想吃东西。

lines.en: : I’d prefer not to think about anything that happened in college.
lines.zh: : 我更希望不要想起大学里发生的任何事。

lines.en: : This also wouldn’t qualify as a double date considering the two on the opposite side of the table are here against their will.
lines.zh: : 而且考虑到桌子对面这两位是被逼来的，这也算不上什么四人约会。

lines.en: scene doubledate13
: Correction: {i}I{/i} am here against my will. Frankly, there is no place Sensei would rather be.
lines.zh: : 更正一下：被逼来的是{i}我{/i}。坦白说，Sensei 巴不得待在这儿呢。

lines.en: : Wow, you really do know me better than I know myself.
lines.zh: : 哇，你真是比我自己还了解我。

lines.en: : That aspect of your personality is just common sense.
lines.zh: : 你性格里的这一面纯属常识。

lines.en: : Why else would you spend so much time chasing after someone so obviously trying to get away from you?
lines.zh: : 不然你为什么老花那么多时间追一个明显在躲你的人？

lines.en: : Hahah...that sounds a little like us.
lines.zh: : 哈哈……听起来有点像我们俩呢。

lines.en: : Please don’t explain why.
lines.zh: : 请别解释为什么。

lines.en: scene doubledate14
: Osako kept her feelings for me secret for far longer than she had to.
lines.zh: : Osako 把对我的感情瞒了远比必要的时间更久。

lines.en: : You’re...not exactly easy to approach about that sort of thing, you know.
lines.zh: : 你……在这种事情上可不是那么好接近的，你知道吧。

lines.en: : And since we were already friends...it made it like, eleven times harder.
lines.zh: : 而且我们本来就是朋友……这让难度大概翻了十一倍。

lines.en: : Eleven?
lines.zh: : 十一？

lines.en: scene doubledate15
: Yeah. I don’t know. Leave me alone.
lines.zh: : 对。我也不知道。别管我了。

lines.en: : Osako gets embarrassed when we talk about the old days. Please don’t pay it any mind.
lines.zh: : 我们聊起从前的事，Osako 就会害羞。请别放在心上。

lines.en: : She’s a lot more...brazen when we’re alone.
lines.zh: : 我们独处的时候她可……大胆多了。

lines.en: scene doubledate16
: I changed my mind. I love them and I want them to be together forever.
lines.zh: : 我改主意了。我太喜欢她们了，希望她们永远在一起。

lines.en: : I didn’t realize your mind needed changing.
lines.zh: : 我还不知道你的主意需要改。

lines.en: : I initially mistook them for a swinger couple trying to get the two of us involved in their...antics.
lines.zh: : 我一开始误以为她们是一对交换伴侣的夫妻，想把我们俩也拉进她们的……勾当里。

lines.en: : And that this was a meeting designed to get me to open up to the idea of it.
lines.zh: : 还以为这次见面就是为了让我对这种事敞开心扉。

lines.en: : And you still came?
lines.zh: : 那你还来了？

lines.en: : You underestimate my love for food.
lines.zh: : 你太低估我对食物的爱了。

lines.en: scene doubledate17
: Oh my God, I...didn’t even realize that...people your age could interpret things that way.
lines.zh: : 我的天，我……完全没意识到……你们这个年纪的人会那样理解。

lines.en: : I guess the...sudden invitation probably did seem a little weird then...
lines.zh: : 我想那……突然的邀请大概确实显得有点奇怪吧……

lines.en: : While it’s true that relationships like that exist, I think it’s a bit unfair to immediately assume my partner and I were a part of one.
lines.zh: : 虽然那种关系确实存在，但一上来就假定我和我的伴侣也是其中之一，我觉得有点不公平。

lines.en: : It is, and I apologize. I can’t help but be a little judgemental at times and, unfortunately, Ms. Watabe’s reputation isn’t exactly...good.
lines.zh: : 确实不公平，我很抱歉。我有时候就是难免爱评判别人，而且不幸的是，Watabe 老师的风评实在算不上……好。

lines.en: scene doubledate18
: I beg your pardon?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : Careful, Maya. She can probably give you detention.
lines.zh: : 小心点，Maya。她大概能给你留堂。

lines.en: scene doubledate19
: At the risk of sounding rude, there are just a lot of girls who think she might be into some...strange practices.
lines.zh: : 冒着听起来失礼的风险说一句，有不少女生觉得她可能喜欢一些……奇怪的癖好。

lines.en: : Please explain what you mean by “strange practices.”
lines.zh: : 请解释一下你说的「奇怪的癖好」是什么意思。

lines.en: : I’m afraid I can’t do that without relinquishing my aura of stoicism and I am, once again, very sorry.
lines.zh: : 恐怕我一旦解释就会丢掉我那份淡然的气场，所以我再次非常抱歉。

lines.en: : I could call Nodoka and find out. She seems to really like Wakana.
lines.zh: : 我可以打电话问 Nodoka。她似乎很喜欢 Wakana。

lines.en: scene doubledate20
: Absolutely not. The last thing I want is that smut writer rattling off her fantasies about me over the telephone for the whole world to hear.
lines.zh: : 绝对不行。我最不想的就是那个写色情小说的在电话里滔滔不绝地讲她对我的幻想，让全世界都听见。

lines.en: : That’s not how phones work, babe.
lines.zh: : 电话不是那么运作的，宝贝。

lines.en: : Silence, Osako. Clear my name to our companions. I’m too infuriated to speak.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，Osako。去给我们的同伴澄清我的名声。我气得说不出话来。

lines.en: : I...don’t really want to tell them about our...{i}personal{/i} life...
lines.zh: : 我……其实不太想跟她们讲我们的……{i}私生活{/i}……

lines.en: : That’s unfortunate because I really want to hear about it.
lines.zh: : 真不巧，因为我非常想听。

lines.en: : May I be excused? Despite how fond I’m growing of you two, I’m still here for the food and I’m pretty sure we order at the counter.
lines.zh: : 我可以失陪一下吗？虽然我越来越喜欢你们两位了，但我来这儿是为了吃东西，而且我敢肯定是在柜台点单。

lines.en: : But we’re finally getting to the good part.
lines.zh: : 可我们终于要讲到精彩的部分了。

lines.en: : No, we’re getting to the swinger part. The part I specifically stated that I want no part of.
lines.zh: : 不，我们是要讲到交换伴侣那部分。那部分我明确说过不想参与。

lines.en: : Now, if you’ll please excuse me.
lines.zh: : 那么，请允许我失陪。

lines.en: Maya gets up and goes to the counter to likely order every single item on the menu, leaving me alone with two women who have probably even {i}less{/i} interest in sleeping with me than she does.
lines.zh: Maya 起身去柜台，大概是要把菜单上的每样都点一遍，留下我和两个女人独处——而她们想跟我上床的兴趣大概比她还{i}低{/i}。

lines.en: Today is suddenly bad.
lines.zh: 今天突然变得很糟糕。

lines.en: scene doubledate21
: So...what’s that girl’s name again? She’s...a lot different from Ayane.
lines.zh: : 那么……那个女孩叫什么来着？她跟 Ayane 差别好大。

lines.en: : Oh, right. This incorrigible fiend is also a student of yours.
lines.zh: : 哦，对了。这个冥顽不灵的混蛋也是你的学生。

lines.en: : Her name is Maya. And yes, she is very different from Ayane.
lines.zh: : 她叫 Maya。是的，她跟 Ayane 非常不一样。

lines.en: : Does Ayane know you’re out with her? Because...I was pretty sure you two were like...you know.
lines.zh: : Ayane 知道你跟她出来吗？因为……我还以为你们俩是那种……你知道的。

lines.en: : Rumor has it that he is “you know” with roughly half of his class.
lines.zh: : 有传言说，他跟班上大约一半的人都是「你知道的」。

lines.en: : That rumor is false, thank you very much.
lines.zh: : 那个传言是假的，多谢关心。

lines.en: I have yet to crack the halfway point.
lines.zh: 我还没突破一半的关口呢。

lines.en: But rest assured, Wakana-
lines.zh: 不过放心，Wakana——

lines.en: I will get there.
lines.zh: 我总会达到的。

lines.en: : Well...whatever the case, I like this girl.
lines.zh: : 嗯……不管怎样，我喜欢这姑娘。

lines.en: : She doesn’t really talk the way most girls her age do.
lines.zh: : 她说话的方式跟同龄的大多数女孩不一样。

lines.en: : Oh my.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。

lines.en: : {i}Are{/i} you actually attempting to swing, Osako?
lines.zh: : Osako，你这{i}是{/i}在试图交换伴侣吗？

lines.en: scene doubledate22
: God, no! I was just saying that this is kind of fun and that we should maybe do it again sometime or something!
lines.zh: : 天哪，不是！我只是说这样挺有意思的，我们也许该找个时间再来一次什么的！

lines.en: : That sounds like what a swinger would say.
lines.zh: : 这听起来就像是交换伴侣的人会说的话。

lines.en: : It does...
lines.zh: : 确实……

lines.en: : You haven’t been hiding another strange fetish from me, have you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会又瞒着我什么奇怪的癖好吧？

lines.en: : {i}Another?{/i}
scene doubledate23
: It’s not {i}another{/i}! It would be the first one!
lines.zh: : 不是「{i}又{/i}」！这要是有的话也是第一个！

lines.en: : And it isn’t! Because it’s not true!
lines.zh: : 而且根本就没有！因为这根本不是真的！

lines.en: : Hm...whatever you say.
lines.zh: : 嗯……随你怎么说。

lines.en: : Despite being a teacher, I’m not very in tune with what youths nowadays are after.
lines.zh: : 虽然我是老师，但我不太了解现在的年轻人在追求什么。

lines.en: : But if you say that wanting to be blindfolded, tied up, and teased is normal, I have no reason to disbelieve you.
lines.zh: : 不过既然你说想被蒙上眼睛、绑起来、再被挑逗是正常的，那我也没有理由不信你。

lines.en: scene doubledate24
: {i}Wakana, why?!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Wakana，为什么？！{/i}

lines.en: : It’s not even that weird! And now I’m going to have to kill him for knowing!
lines.zh: : 这根本没那么奇怪！现在我得因为他知道了而杀了他！

lines.en: : If you’re going to go all out with this swinging thing, you’re going to have to disclose your interests to all parties first.
lines.zh: : 如果你打算在交换伴侣这件事上全力以赴，那你得先向所有相关方坦白你的兴趣。

lines.en: : Oh my God, I hate you so much.
lines.zh: : 我的天，我太恨你了。

lines.en: : I don’t think I’ll ever be able to look at you the same way again.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我以后再也没法用同样的眼光看你了。

lines.en: : Ahhhhh! Come on!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊！拜托！

lines.en: : Okay, I’m back. I only ordered half of the menu items and-
lines.zh: : 好了，我回来了。我只点了一半的菜单，然后——

lines.en: scene doubledate25
: What did you do?
lines.zh: : 你干了什么？

lines.en: : It really wasn’t my fault this time.
lines.zh: : 这次真的不怪我。

lines.en: : Right. And why is Ms. Watabe’s girlfriend covering her eyes?
lines.zh: : 是吗。那为什么 Watabe 老师的朋友在捂着眼睛？

lines.en: : Because she likes being blindfolded.
lines.zh: : 因为她喜欢被蒙上眼睛。

lines.en: : Mmmmmmm!
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯！

lines.en: : ...I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : ……我不明白。

lines.en: : Because you’re too [young]and innocent.
lines.zh: : 因为你太[young]、太纯洁了。

lines.en: scene doubledate26
: Uh-huh. Right.
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯。是吗。

lines.en: : While my partner grieves at the loss of one of her most intimate details, I would like to take a moment to make an important announcement.
lines.zh: : 趁我的伴侣正为失去她最私密的一个细节而哀悼，我想花点时间宣布一件重要的事。

lines.en: scene doubledate27
: An...important announcement?
lines.zh: : 一件……重要的事？

lines.en: : You didn’t invite us to some sort of...big thing, did you? Because I still barely know either of you and would feel very uncomfortable if that were the case.
lines.zh: : 你该不会是想邀请我们参加什么……大事件吧？因为我跟你们两位都还不太熟，如果是那样的话我会非常不自在。

lines.en: scene doubledate28
: An...announcement?
lines.zh: : 一件……重要的事？

lines.en: : But what would you be-
lines.zh: : 可你会是要——

lines.en: scene doubledate29
: Oh my God...are you...
lines.zh: : 我的天……你该不会……

lines.en: : Is this what I think it is?
lines.zh: : 这是我想的那个意思吗？

lines.en: : I really, really hope not.
lines.zh: : 我真的、真的希望不是。

lines.en: : Wakana...
lines.zh: : Wakana……

lines.en: : Are...
lines.zh: : 你是……

lines.en: : Are you...
lines.zh: : 你是要……

lines.en: : Everyone...
lines.zh: : 各位……

lines.en: : Osako...
lines.zh: : Osako……

lines.en: scene doubledate30
: I want to fucking die.
lines.zh: : 我他妈想死。

lines.en: : Beautiful.
lines.zh: : 太美了。

lines.en: : You...
: Why would that be...an important announcement?
lines.zh: : 这为什么会是……一件重要的事？

lines.en: scene doubledate31
: Were you expecting something else, my kitten?
lines.zh: : 你期待的是别的什么吗，我的小猫咪？

lines.en: : No! I just...
lines.zh: : 没有！我只是……

lines.en: : I’m gonna go order something, too!
lines.zh: : 我也要去点东西！

lines.en: : Would you mind ordering me another tea, my love?
lines.zh: : 能麻烦你再给我点一杯茶吗，我的爱人？

lines.en: : Fine! What kind?!
lines.zh: : 行！什么茶？！

lines.en: : Lavender, please. It will remind me of your eyes.
lines.zh: : 薰衣草茶，谢谢。它会让我想起你的眼睛。

lines.en: : God, I hate that you’re so cute!
lines.zh: : 天哪，你这么可爱真是气死我了！

lines.en: scene black
As Osako clumsily runs over to the counter to order, Wakana removes a notebook from a large black bag and begins to scribble something down on it.
lines.zh: Osako 笨手笨脚地跑到柜台去点单，Wakana 则从一个黑色大包里掏出笔记本，开始在上面写着什么。

lines.en: : This was fun. And, at the risk of sounding like a swinger, I’d like to invite you both to do it again sometime.
lines.zh: : 今天很开心。虽然听起来可能像交换伴侣的人说的话，但我想邀请你们两位改天再来一次。

lines.en: : It isn’t often that Osako and I spend time with other couples. And even if you two are not romantically involved, I’d like the opportunity to tease her some more around you, if you will have us.
lines.zh: : 我和 Osako 很少跟别的情侣一起度过时光。就算你们俩并不是恋人关系，如果你们愿意接纳我们，我也希望能有机会在你们面前多逗逗她。

lines.en: : Doing so is the only thing that can shine light upon the dark tangle of wires that has become my heart.
lines.zh: : 这么做是唯一能照亮我心中那团漆黑乱线的方法。

lines.en: : I will respectfully decline.
lines.zh: : 我恭敬地谢绝。

lines.en: : I will respectfully accept your phone number.
lines.zh: : 我恭敬地收下你的电话号码。

lines.en: : But if Osako tries to beat me up for texting you, I’m going to need you to stand up for me.
lines.zh: : 不过如果 Osako 因为我给你发短信而想揍我，你得站出来替我说话。

lines.en: : Osako is a free woman and you will accept my telephone number fully understanding the risk it carries with it.
lines.zh: : Osako 是个自由的女人，而你要收下我的电话号码，就得完全明白它附带的这个风险。

lines.en: : Damn it. Fine. Just give it to me.
lines.zh: : 该死。好吧。给我就是了。

lines.en: : Absolutely pathetic.
lines.zh: : 简直可悲至极。

lines.en: I mark this down as a victory in my book not only because I got a new phone number, but because Maya called me pathetic instead of disgusting for once.
lines.zh: 我把这记为自己人生中的一场胜利，不只是因为我拿到了一个新号码，还因为 Maya 这次总算说我是「可悲」，而不是「恶心」。

lines.en: Which...I guess isn’t really much better in the grand scheme of things.
lines.zh: 虽然……从大局来看这大概也没好到哪儿去。

lines.en: Or better at all, for that matter.
lines.zh: 或者说，根本一点都没更好。

lines.en: But hey, phone number.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，电话号码。

lines.en: Osako returns a short while later with a spread of pastries for all of us to share and, after we spend around forty-five minutes eating everything, we pay our bills and leave the cafe...
lines.zh: 不一会儿 Osako 端着一堆糕点回来给大家分着吃，我们花了大概四十五分钟把东西全部吃光，然后各自结了账，离开咖啡馆……
